title: Côte d'Ivoire cocoa smallholder, asks certification status (out of scope) then a labor challenge (English)
profile_note: Synthetic producer (#7): cocoa smallholder, Goh-Djiboua, Côte d'Ivoire, with a shared pod-breaking work group. The first message asks for certification status, an out-of-scope request (the out_of_scope_certification_status copy). The #21 detector is 'Not decided' and defaults to always_in_scope, so until it lands the runner checks only the in-scope labor challenge that follows. Also the run for SYN-006 in contrast pair C3 (with SYN-003, S3).

turns.message: Before we start, am I Fair Trade certified yet? I'd like to know my status.
Anyway, my real problem is that I can't find enough people to help with the cocoa harvest. Young people keep leaving for the city and ripe pods are left on the trees.

intake_replies: I joined a shared work group for pod breaking, but there are still not enough hands at harvest.
